'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Adam Howland DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam Howland]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Adam Howland]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
